alt: a double-height library with a sunken reading level, shown in four material schemes: pale maple and cobalt, sand and black, in different surface combinations. firelight and lamplight, rooftops visible through windows.
text:
cobalt walls hold firelight. pale walls let it float away.

a double-height library in four material schemes. same space, different how firelight moves. cobalt holds warmth; pale surfaces let it pass through.

the saturated one is the one it wanted to be.

#jeweltonelibrary #librarydesign #deepcolour #colourtheory #materialdesign
